subject: Re: Aperture Systems - Solution Integrator Launch & Enablement Framework
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@aperturesystems.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@aperturesystems.com>, Sam Kerr <sam.kerr@aperturesystems.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aperture x Redwood - kickoff & enablement cadence

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Aperture is eager to start the SI enablement so our solutions team can confidently scope and deploy Redwood-backed features for our clients. We'd like a practical enablement plan — not just slides: role-based training, a hands-on sandbox lab, go-to-market collateral, and a lightweight certification path for our consultants.

Quick asks to move fast:
- Draft of the week-by-week enablement curriculum (4-6 weeks)
- Sample lab exercises and expected outcomes for each role (SE, sales engineer, engagement manager)
- Any partner program requirements (NDA, reseller terms, certification criteria)

Can you share a proposed play framework this week? We're targeting a pilot with one client by mid-March.

Regards,
Oliver Grant
Head of Solutions, Aperture Systems
[Attachment: aperture-capabilities-overview.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@aperturesystems.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@aperturesystems.com>, Sam Kerr <sam.kerr@aperturesystems.com>, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aperture x Redwood - kickoff & enablement cadence

Hi Oliver — great to hear the pilot timeline. I pulled together a concise partner-enablement framework that maps directly to the pilot milestones. Attached is a first draft playdeck plus a skill matrix for the roles you called out.

High-level proposal (summary):
1) Week 0: Partner orientation + paperwork (NDA, MSA redline window, partner addendum).
2) Weeks 1–2: Technical deep-dive + hands-on lab (SEs + platform engineers). Live lab exercises, pre-built dataset, and a Redwood sandbox (dedicated tenant) for testing.
3) Week 3: Sales & solution workshops (demo scripts, objection handling, pricing guidance).
4) Week 4: Enablement assessment + certification run (practical exam & project checklist).
5) Week 5–6: Pilot support & post-mortem (SLA handoff, escalation path, feedback loop).

Action items I need from you to finalize the schedule:
- Confirm number of participants per role (approx).
- Pilot client target and expected integration scope (routing/personalization/embedding use cases).
- Any compliance constraints (data residency, audit logs) for the sandbox environment.

Attachments: SI_playdeck_v1.pptx; partner-skill-map.xlsx; aperture-mapping-notes.pdf

I'll loop in Partnerships and Enablement leads (Sergio and Marissa) for logistics and GTM collateral. If useful, we can run a shorter "rapid start" 2-week track for a subset of your team.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SI_playdeck_v1.pptx (PPTX, 2.2MB)]

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aperture x Redwood - kickoff & enablement cadence

Looping in logistics and enablement ops. A few practical notes from partner ops:
- We can provision a gated sandbox (dedicated tenant) for Aperture within 3 business days once legal clears the partner addendum.
- For the lab exercises we should include two baseline workloads (customer-facing chat flow + embeddings-based search) so SEs see both latency and cost tradeoffs.
- Marissa, can you draft a 1-pager for the sales play that includes recommended pricing buckets and two example SOW line items (pilot + rollout)?

I recommend a 1-hour "launch" session to align execs and PMs, then role-specific deep dives. Vanessa, please start a shared calendar for week-of workshops and add meeting owners.

Thanks — Sergio
Director, Partnerships Programs
[Attachment: none]

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@aperturesystems.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@aperturesystems.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aperture x Redwood - kickoff & enablement cadence

Thanks — this looks great. A couple of specifics from our side:
- Participants: 3 SEs, 2 Solutions Architects, 2 Engagement Managers, and 1 Sales Lead.
- Pilot target: retail client (US, multi-region) focusing on personalized recommendations via embeddings + a conversational assistant for customer service.
- Compliance: client requires US-only data sandbox, and we need audit logs for the trial.

Timing note: we have an internal blackout week Feb 15–19, so earlier the better. Can the sandbox be available by Feb 10?

Also: curious about a lightweight certification badge we can show in proposals — what does Redwood typically require for that?

Best,
Priya Rao
Partner Programs Manager, Aperture Systems
[Attachment: pilot-scope-draft.docx (DOCX, 78KB)]

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@aperturesystems.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@aperturesystems.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aperture x Redwood - kickoff & enablement cadence

Thanks for the details — this is helpful. Quick commitments and next steps: 
1) Sandbox: ops can provision a US-only dedicated sandbox by Feb 9 if legal returns the partner addendum by EOD Feb 4. We'll include token-level audit logs and a retention window matching the pilot needs.
2) Participants confirmed: we'll plan for your headcount and send invites for role-specific sessions the week of Feb 8 (we'll avoid the blackout).
3) Certification: Redwood's "Integrator Certified" badge requires a short practical assessment (hands-on lab + checklist). For partners in good standing we fast-track certification post-pilot; I'll attach the certification rubric for visibility.

Marissa — can you share the sales play 1-pager and two SOW line items by EOD Feb 4 so Aperture can review? Vanessa — please schedule the launch call for Feb 9, 10am PT (tentative) and add all internal owners.

Oliver/Priya — if that plan works, we'll treat Feb 9 as the formal kickoff and send calendar invites once legal confirms.

Cheers,
Soojin
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: integrator-cert-rubric.pdf (PDF, 125KB)]
